tasks.short: Send product samples for laboratory analysis

tasks.enabler_now: Record software does not remove packaging and dispatch work.
tasks.still_hard: Mix-ups, contamination and inappropriate handling can invalidate analysis.
tasks.human_edge: The operator checks the actual sample and resolves unclear submission requirements.
tasks.altitude: Sample-handoff responsibility and time remain unchanged.

tasks.short: Complete work tickets and place them with products

steps.what: Verify products and capture the work ticket's job and quantity details
Complete the work ticket with the verified fields
Check the printed ticket and place it with the correct products

tasks.design: Configure a work-ticket template in {OPS_SYSTEM} that prints the operator's verified fields once. The operator checks the printed identity and quantity against the actual lot and places the ticket with it; printing does not establish product conformity or correct physical attachment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ticket fields can be written again after the operator has identified the lot.
tasks.enabler_now: Native ticket printing can populate fixed fields without a model.
tasks.still_hard: A correct ticket can still be attached to the wrong products.
tasks.human_edge: The operator compares the ticket with the physical lot at handoff.
tasks.altitude: Less ticket transcription, with physical traceability checks unchanged.

reach.learn: Lot identifiers and controlled ticket replacement

evidence.claim: Native work-ticket generation from checked fields is an E1 model-knowledge design; no digest source documents this ticket-printing case.

assumptions: Boundary is ticket capture, completion and physical placement, not production or inspection of all product characteristics.

In s1 the operator produces job ID, product ID, lot ID, quantity, unit, operation and date. All 25 hours remain for capture and matching to actual products. Missing IDs or unavailable printing require manual ticket completion and checking.
Test native ticket printing before code. No free structured discrepancy code or automatic conformity status is assumed; ticket population is the only removed labour.
Allow four focal hours for printer/template upkeep and fallback ticket reconciliation beyond routine placement checks.
unknowns: Native ticket template and floor printer availability
research_questions: Can printed tickets preserve exact lot identity and remain readable through the next production handoff?
